data.long_description:
Farm Gardens 2 is the second phase of Emaar's luxury project, set in the scenic area of The Valley. This exclusive development features a collection of opulent 4-5 bedroom villas.


  The community offers spacious villas with modern interiors, high-end finishes, and captivating views of green landscapes. Each farmhouse-style home seamlessly combines functionality and elegance, ensuring a comfortable living experience.

On the grounds, residents will find a variety of leisure and recreational facilities such as children's and adult pools, a gazebo, vegetable growing area and a greenhouse. The project has everything necessary for an active and relaxed lifestyle. The main feature of the complex is its proximity to nature and opportunities to enjoy all the benefits of the outdoors: picturesque parks, walking paths and vast green spaces where residents can relax and enjoy nature. Here you can go out for a walk or organize a picnic with family and friends while enjoying the fresh air and the beauty of the surrounding landscape.

Farm Gardens 2 has a unique location. Rugby Sevens is 5 minutes away. Dubai Outlet Mall is 8 minutes away, while Burj Khalifa and Downtown Dubai are 25 minutes away. You can also reach Dubai International Airport in just 25 minutes.

Finance is available on this property through Premier Property Finance. Call us on +97143233609 for a free consultation.
